svg.title: Multi-region Secrets Manager: a three-node cluster per region across three zones, snapshots replicated from Region A to Region B, and key holders in both regions
svg.text: Pods, VMs and pipelines in any region
Raft replication inside the region, mutual TLS on 8201
3 of 5 shares, reachable in both regions
Solid lines carry live traffic and data. Dashed lines activate during a regional failover.
